_readme: The published tenant-theme population (TASK-027 step 6). Contrast is gated against the themes real tenants run, never just the default token set: testing defaults proves nothing about the population that matters. Each theme is an override layer over the tenant-token vocabulary below — the same defaults the admin theme editor seeds and the backend resolves against. Mirrored from the storefront mock's served themes and the visual-matrix theme set; a theme added to the platform must be added here, because `pnpm check:contrast --themes=published` is only as real as this list.
